title: In an email to staff, new interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress cites "an extraordinarily difficult period" and sets a company meeting for November 18 (Terrence O'Brien/The Verge)
summary: Terrence O'Brien / The Verge: In an email to staff, new interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress cites “an extraordinarily difficult period” and sets a company meeting for November 18 — Nvidia's board and interim CEO Colette Kress told employees they're ready to ‘move forward together.’
